items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) will not travel to London and is ruled out for Sunday vs Jaguars, along with S Jalen Pitre and WR Tank Dell.
items.why: Groin injury; team decision not to travel for London game.
items.implication: Clears path for backup RB workhorse role in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity for remaining Texans RBs; red-zone/goal-line upside elevated.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled out for Week 6 vs Panthers due to superficial blood clot in calf discovered via ultrasound; situation ongoing and he is out indefinitely until resolved. Tanner McKee expected to start.
items.why: Follow-up ultrasound showed movement in small blood clot after initial discovery post-London trip; health priority.
items.implication: Major QB downgrade for Eagles offense; streaming/backup QB needed in fantasy; pass-catchers may see volume shifts under McKee.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for Eagles RBs/WRs/TEs in short-term if McKee forces more checkdowns or run game.

items.text: No practice again for Saquon Barkley (hamstring); DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited practice Thursday.
items.why: Barkley hamstring ongoing DNP; Smith hamstring/toe progressing to limited.
items.implication: Barkley questionable/GTD risk with Hurts also out; Smith trending better for availability.
items.opportunity: If Barkley out, backup RB snaps/carries spike; Smith return boosts WR corps.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice did not practice again Thursday due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Ongoing hamstring issue from prior week; multi-week risk reported.
items.implication: High risk of missing or limited Week 6; targets redistribute in KC offense.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Xavier Worthy and other KC WRs/TEs if out.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson officially did not practice again Thursday with ankle injury.
items.why: Ankle injury sustained earlier; second straight DNP.
items.implication: Uncertain for Week 6; Tyler Huntley likely if out, impacting Ravens skill players' ceilings.
items.opportunity: If out, checkdown/TE volume up; Flowers still viable but lower ceiling.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant second straight day, on track to start Sunday vs Falcons. Kyle Monangai likely misses second straight.
items.why: Full practice participation consecutive days post-hamstring.
items.implication: QB upgrade for Bears skill players; start Williams in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: Full dropback volume returns; RB committee if Monangai out.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty said he is feeling great and this is the best he’s felt this season; positive update amid ankle/foot issues.
items.why: Player comments after full practice; coach confirms playing and feeling better; ankle off report.
items.implication: Clears Jeanty for full workload vs Bills as RB2 with volume.
items.opportunity: Maintains high snap/carry/target share; no rest this week despite prior rumors.

items.text: Breece Hall will not practice and remains week-to-week. RB snaps in two full games since injury: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0.
items.why: Coach Aaron Glenn update; clear snap hierarchy post-injury.
items.implication: Allen is the clear lead back while Hall sidelined; stash Hall but start Allen if available.
items.opportunity: Near-workhorse snaps/carries for Allen; Davis change-of-pace only.

items.text: Drake London loved as WR6 vs CHI due to bankable usage.
Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) due to tough matchup and QB issues.
items.why: Ugly matchup vs Seattle and shaky QB situation.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) for elite recent usage and soft run defense.
items.why: Elite usage lately vs defenses leaking vs run.
items.implication: RB1 start with volume and TD upside.

items.text: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars. Saquon Barkley turns 30 in February. If Super Bowl contender with RB need, I'd at least call.
items.why: Historical Eagles pattern of trading aging stars before decline; age milestone approaching amid current injury.
items.implication: Long-term dynasty/redraft caution; potential trade candidate ROS if contenders call.
items.opportunity: Current role still strong if healthy, but future snap share risk.

items.text: LOVE love love Mike Evans against Commanders secondary this week. Evans is my WR4 for Week 6.
items.why: Elite matchup vs Washington secondary that is a nightmare for WRs; strong usage expected.
items.implication: Must-start WR1/2 upside in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: High target/red-zone share vs soft pass defense.

items.text: Jaylen Warren has monster day as Rico Dowdle’s return looms; Dowdle presumably lost job, added to One Injury Away as no standalone value.
items.why: Warren dominant recent production (most yards in 3-game stretch); Dowdle toe and role loss.
items.implication: Warren workhorse RB2/flex; Dowdle handcuff only.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/carries/routes for Warren even with Dowdle return.
